name: Harmonious Mantra recovers 3 damage from the champion
notes: Harmonious Mantra's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. The champion is pre-patched with 5 damage so the recover effect is observable. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid. Shifting Currents default to a non-North direction, so the base Recover 3 applies rather than the North-facing Recover 3+LV bonus.
